svg.title: 3D Portfolio — project card
svg.desc: My personal site: a real-time 3D scene, orbiting skill planets, playable game builds and 25 design case studies across UI, brand and packaging. Built with Next.Js, R3F, Gsap, Tailwind. Live demo. Banner: the game's real title screen.
